document_kind: inert design intent, NOT a UTM config.plist or importable .utm bundle
name: fort-utm-isolation-probe

boot.type: native Linux direct kernel/initrd; UEFI false
boot.kernel_source: inspected ARM64 Image from signed Ubuntu tar; bounded gzip decompression only if necessary
boot.gate: Exact archive member paths, ARM64 header, root label/filesystem/layout and initrd compatibility must be established. No guessed member path or QCOW passthrough.

drives.source: one accepted raw disk from archive, retained at original size; no resize/conversion/duplicate

drives.contents: only reviewed synthetic user-data, meta-data and network-config; root-owned seed files, no secret keys

serial_devices.role: bounded boot and fixed pre/postflight evidence; no login shell
one fixed prepare/grant/heartbeat/stop controller session; no shell or arbitrary command

usb: No physical device attachment/autoconnect. UTM source adds virtual xHCI controller on macOS 15+ even with no attached devices.

guest.uid_1000: fort-admin locked-password, nologin, no sudo; no interactive administrator path
guest.root_broker: guest-only management service starts after successful provisioning; never starts runtime or tool without exact synthetic grant
guest.ssh: disabled; no authorized keys; suppress key generation
guest.firewall: defense-in-depth drop-all non-loopback; no NIC/DHCP/NAT rules copied from Lima

control_invariants.readiness_identity: VM package UUID + exact owner/process/PTY + guest boot ID + installation/epoch/attempt/generation/unit invocation/cgroup

new_source_changes_needed: replace SSH host session with bounded exclusive PTY transport
root serial broker/inspection service with raw terminal mode and no login/getty conflict
NoCloud seed installation and no-NIC package/device readiness checks
